description.en: Birthdays, parties and Dutch holidays: congratulating the whole family, choosing and wrapping gifts, Sinterklaas and New Year's Eve, and saying thank you

units.text: Van harte gefeliciteerd met je verjaardag!
Mijn verjaardag is op vijf december.

translation.en: My birthday is on December fifth.

en: My birthday is on September fifth.
My sister's birthday is on December fifth.
es-419: Mi cumpleaños es el cinco de septiembre.
El cumpleaños de mi hermana es el cinco de diciembre.

translation.es-419: Mi hermana cumple treinta años hoy.

Mi hermana cumple treinta años mañana.

es-419: felicidades por el cumpleaños de tu papá

Thanks for your sister's present, Sanne!

units.text: We vieren het zaterdag met de hele familie.

translation.en: We're celebrating on Saturday with the whole family.

We're celebrating on Saturday with a few friends.

Lo celebramos el sábado con unos amigos.

separable inpakken: Ik pak het vanavond in

units.text: Wat geef ik hem voor zijn verjaardag?

translation.en: What should I give him for his birthday?

en: What should I give her for her birthday?
What should I buy him for his birthday?

units.text: Ik geef haar een boek, want ze leest graag.

translation.en: I'm giving her a book, because she likes to read.
translation.es-419: Le regalo un libro, porque le gusta leer.

en: I'm giving her a book, because she likes to cook.
I'm giving her a newspaper, because she likes to read.

en: I'd rather give him something cute.

units.text: Fijne feestdagen en tot volgend jaar!

es-419: ¡Felices fiestas y hasta la próxima semana!

translation.es-419: en la noche de fin de año

Can I unwrap the present later?
